name: lint
summary: Every static check in one command (CHG-0045): tsc for web, server, tools/tests/shared and the glossary; ESLint (typescript-eslint strict type-checked, no any) with a suppression baseline that may only shrink. `--staged` checks what is staged (the pre-commit hook); `install` sets that hook (bd size + bd lint).
outputs: JSON {staged, outcomes{check: pass|fail|skip}, failed[]} on stdout; findings on stderr; exit 1 on any failure
